description: Governor's  Secretariat - Sabaragamuwa Province - Fifth Supplementary Financil Statement 2018, Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to public sector financial administration and expenditure authorization for a Provincial Council. It involves the granting of permission to disburse funds for various public services (health, transport, housing, etc.) and specifies recurrent and capital expenditure allocations across different government departments and programs. This falls under public service administration and financial management, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
